name: pau_fixed
description: The fully-learned PAU (Pade Activation Unit, order (5,4), one {a,b} pair shared across all 6 blocks) from the imagenet1k_100ep pau_global run, frozen and reused here as a FIXED activation function -- the PAU counterpart of fact_fixed.

source_run.note: three ImageNet-1K seeds of pau_global exist (seeds 1-3; this artifact is seed 1's final epoch). They converge to nearly the same curve -- final-epoch a0 = -0.080734, -0.079127, -0.078951 -- so the curve is not a single draw. All three are published as arun-AiBharat/LeFT-activation-transfer :: source_imagenet1k_vit_d6/cv_imagenet1k_pau_global_seed<N>_<best|final>.pt.

best_val_checkpoint_coeffs.note: the best-val checkpoint (epoch 97) vs this final-epoch one; the frozen PAU arm uses the FINAL-epoch curve, whereas fact_fixed was extracted from its source run's best-validation checkpoint (cv_imagenet1k_fact_k2_global_seed1_best.pt)

gelu_fit_init.note: the least-squares Pade fit to GELU on [-pi, pi] these coefficients STARTED from (pau_global_evolution.json's 'init'), i.e. the run began as a faithful GELU copy

curve_diagnostics.pole_margin_note: PAU.forward's Q = 1 + sum_k |b_k| t^k is NOT >= 1 as the 'safe PAU' formulation claims (t^k is signed for odd k). This curve dips to Q = 0.854652 near t = -0.427 but never reaches 0, so it is pole-free and usable frozen.
curve_diagnostics.tail_note: f(t) -> -0.522460 * t as |t| -> inf: the learned curve is eventually DECREASING in both tails, unlike every fixed baseline in the zoo and unlike the frozen FAct curve (which is periodic, so it has no tail slope at all).
